findings.title: The appeal draft is not an update in the contract's shape
findings.input: jsonschema Draft 2020-12 validation of the draft against contracts/update.schema.json
findings.what_happens: 9 errors: headline, categories, history missing; title, body, draft, visa, regime, status_detail, absence_checks not allowed; claims carry saved_copy, docket_entry, entry_date_filed, fetched_at. Point 29 drops any update that fails the schema, so approved as written it can never be shown, while publish_blockers would return nothing.

findings.title: Draft states 'The order remains in force' as fact; the First Circuit docket was not read
findings.input: body sentence 'The order remains in force.' with absence_checks.not_checked naming the unread 26-2112 docket
findings.what_happens: A stay pending appeal entered by the First Circuit would not be in the district listing searched. Also 'The final rule changes' is present tense for an enjoined rule.
